statement: For both Joy-Con 2 USB product matches, the Linux Nintendo configuration driver binds a vendor-specific USB interface and uses discovered bulk endpoints for command and reply traffic, while the HID driver supplies input processing. Pinned SDL claims the libusb interface, discovers bulk endpoints on interface 1, and performs staged command and calibration reads. A UHID device alone cannot provide this USB interface topology.

applicability.scope: USB configuration and HID input split; host-side only
